_comment: Editorial content for JSRR. This is a REIT scheme, not an operating company: it is a trust managed by a licensed REIT Management Company, so the fields below describe the scheme and its manager. It has no products of its own. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: JS Rental REIT (JSRR) is a rental REIT scheme registered with SECP on 20 May 2022 under a trust deed dated 28 December 2021 between JS Investments Limited, as the REIT Management Company, and Digital Custodian Company Limited, as trustee. Its asset is Plot No. SB-5/28 on Abdullah Haroon Road, Saddar, Karachi — about 35,892 sq ft, held on a 99-year government lease that runs from 1 March 1962 to 28 February 2061. The scheme listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange after an offer for sale of units by its sponsor, JS Lands (Private) Limited, in 2026.
headOffice: 19th Floor, The Centre, Plot No. SB-5, Abdullah Haroon Road, Saddar, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: JS Rental REIT abridged offer for sale document (JS Investments Limited, April 2026) and the PSX Data Portal security record for JSRR, read 2026-10-17.
